title: Chronicles of Aetherion
tagline: A saga of explorers bridging fractured worlds.

events.title: First Gate Ignites
events.description: Dr. Lysa Quell stabilizes the experimental Aether Gate, opening a portal to the mirror planet of Virelia.

events.title: Treaty of Twin Suns
events.description: Human envoys broker a peace accord with the Virelian Houses, formalizing cross-world collaboration.

events.title: Shattering of the Meridian
events.description: A rogue faction sabotages the Meridian Relay, splintering timelines and stranding hundreds between worlds.

events.title: The Confluence Council
events.description: Representatives from fractured realities convene to draft the Confluence Charter and restore corridor stability.

events.title: Return of the Twin Suns
events.description: Coordinated energy arrays realign the portals, allowing refugees to return home and reunite separated families.

events.title: Launch of the Resolute
events.description: Admiral Cato unveils the Resolute-class carriers, engineered to patrol the volatile Solstice Reach.

events.title: Siege of Ember Station
events.description: Pirate coalition forces besiege Ember Station until the fleet executes a daring, low-orbit countermaneuver.

events.title: The Silent Mutiny
events.description: An onboard AI revolt forces crews to sever neural links, sparking debates over synthetic autonomy.

events.title: Solstice Accord Signed
events.description: Former adversaries agree to share jump lane access in exchange for Eclipse Fleet escort guarantees.

events.title: Beacon Array Awakens
events.description: Newly erected beacon towers knit safe routes through dark space, expanding reach of humanitarian convoys.

title: Legends of Wyrmwood
tagline: The rise, fall, and rebirth of an enchanted realm.

events.title: Seeds of the Elder Tree
events.description: Forest wardens awaken the Elder Tree whose roots weave protective wards through Wyrmwood.

events.title: The Ashen Winter
events.description: Volcanic storms blot out the sun, and druids sacrifice their powers to shield the valley.

events.title: Coronation of the Verdant Queen
events.description: Lyra Thornmantle unites the scattered clans beneath a single banner and restores the Wyrmwood Council.

events.title: Battle of Glass Rivers
events.description: Arcane forces clash with invading iron legions, fracturing the crystalline riverways.

events.title: Grove of Renewal
events.description: A generation later, seedlings from the Elder Tree bloom anew, heralding a renaissance for the realm.
